why: Builds hand strength and control without looking at the ball.
say: Pound it hard, keep it below your knee, and eyes on me the whole time.
how: Spread out facing the coach, one ball each.
20 seconds each: right pound, left pound, crossover, between legs, behind back.
Coach holds up fingers — players call out the number.
h: Add a second ball or a tennis ball toss.

st: Pound hard in place — call out the coach's fingers

why: Forces the weak hand to work as hard as the strong hand.
say: Two balls, same time, then alternate — don't let the weak hand quit.
how: One ball in each hand.
Same-time dribbles 20s, alternating 20s.
Add: high-low, side-to-side, walking forward.

st: Two balls at once, then walk them forward

why: Fast hands and feel for the ball around the body.
say: Wrap the ball in a figure 8 through your legs — fast but in control.
how: Feet wide, knees bent.
Pass the ball through the legs in a figure 8, 30s.
Then dribble the figure 8, 30s each direction.

st: Figure 8 through the legs, then dribble it

why: Change of direction with the correct hand, ending in a finish.
say: Weave the cones, switch hands at every cone, and finish strong.
how: Set 4 cones in a line from half court to the lane.
Weave through, crossing over at each cone.
Finish with a layup, rebound, back of the line.
h: Between legs or behind back at each cone.

st: Weave the cones, switch hands each time

why: Practices game moves at speed in open court.
say: Change direction at every turn using the move I call.
how: Start in the corner, zig-zag to the other end.
Coach calls the move: crossover, between legs, spin, behind back.
Return down the other side.
cue: Sell the move with your shoulders
h: Add a defender with hands behind back.

st: Zig-zag the floor, change direction at each turn

why: Teaches pushing the ball ahead in transition.
say: Push the ball out in front and outrun it to the other end.
how: Lines on the baseline.
Speed dribble the full court with the right hand, finish.
Back with the left hand.
h: Race the player next to you, loser does 5 push-ups.

st: Speed dribble — push the ball ahead

why: Escapes pressure and resets the attack.
say: Attack the cone, retreat two dribbles, then explode past it.
how: Attack the cone with 2–3 hard dribbles.
Retreat dribble back 2 steps, keep eyes up.
Re-attack with a move and finish.

why: Reps of one move into a finish, game speed.
say: Pretend the cone is a defender — make your move at the cone and go score.
how: Cone at the top of the key.
Attack with speed, make the called move at the cone.
Finish at the rim; rotate.
cue: Move at the cone, not before

st: Make the move and turn the corner

say: Two balls full court — keep them both low and moving.
how: Dribble two balls full court together.
Back alternating.
Advanced: crossovers with both balls.

why: Ball handling against real pressure; defense works too.
say: Ball handler zig-zags full court; defender forces turns without reaching.
how: Pairs in each sideline lane.
Defender stays in front, forcing direction changes.
Switch roles at the far end.
cue: Handler: protect ball with off arm
Defender: beat them to the spot

st: Handler zig-zags, defender cuts them off

why: Builds eyes-up dribbling and hand-eye coordination.
say: Keep dribbling while you catch and toss the tennis ball back.
how: Partner or coach tosses a tennis ball.
Player catches it with the free hand while dribbling.
Toss back; switch hands every 30s.
h: Two players dribbling, toss the tennis ball to each other.

st: Dribble while catching and tossing with the coach

say: Slow down like you're stopping, then explode by.
how: Dribble at the cone at medium speed.
Hesitate: rise up, eyes to the rim.
Explode past with a long first step; finish.
cue: Sell it with eyes and shoulders
h: Coach live defender at the cone.

why: Zig-zag control, then a blow-by with the defender on your back and a shot-fake finish.
say: Zig-zag, then blow by — get him on your back, shot fake, and go up.
how: Partners full court: one dribbles, one defends.
Zig-zag to half court with the defender cutting you off.
Blow by: beat him to the rim and get him on your back.
Shot fake at the rim and go up. Switch roles coming back.
h: Defender plays live after half court.

st: Blow by — get him on your back
